calls.video_title: Massive Update for Texas Instruments Stock Investors
calls.stance_flip: BUY->HOLD (downgrade stated in video; prior BUY reiterated 28 Aug 2026 per creator, not in tracked calls.json)
calls.thesis: Downgraded to HOLD: no longer a buying opportunity after +66% YTD — revenue +23%, 61% gross margins, $6.5B TTM FCF, price hikes and industrial/auto/data-center recovery, but valuation stretched.
calls.base_case: Forward P/E ~27 (near most expensive this year) vs ~14-15 at start of 2026; DCF also points to stretched (fair-value figure garbled in captions, not recorded).
calls.bull_case: Operating margins (now >38%) could surpass prior peak in next 18 months; ROIC 19.4% is ~2x WACC even off lows, >40% at peaks.
calls.bear_case: Semiconductor cyclicality evident over past decade — TTM revenue $19.45B still below 2023 peak >$20B; no margin of safety at current price.
